scope: Eager user-stack measurement and design; production behavior unchanged
qemu: 11.1.3 TCG, 2 vCPUs, optical compressed module, user-mode fixture NIC

measurement.counts: Unique sampled tuples per phase, preserving first appearance; raw logs retain repeats and timing
measurement.touch_depth: Deepest user PTE with accessed bit; no exact RSP or live byte claim
measurement.limitations: Direct-map copies invisible to A/D bits; worker PTE swaps/exit can lose history; sibling execution can continue during samples
